description: This file contains display utility functions for sandbox CLI, including functions to display containers, browsers, summaries, recreate previews, and results, with external dependencies on sandbox formatters, CLI command formatter, and time formatting.

methods.name: displayItems
methods.description: Generic function to display a list of items with a given configuration and runtime.

methods.name: displayContainers
methods.description: Displays a list of sandbox container information.

methods.name: displayBrowsers
methods.description: Displays a list of sandbox browser container information.

methods.name: displaySummary
methods.description: Displays a summary of sandbox containers and browsers, including counts and mismatches.

methods.name: displayRecreatePreview
methods.description: Shows a preview of runtimes to be recreated.

methods.name: displayRecreateResult
methods.description: Displays the result of recreate operation, success and failure counts.
